Button map

Desktop
Experimental hardware write · supported Logitech onboard profiles.
Orbit detects the reported profile format and button count, exports a full backup before writing, changes only the selected button records, recalculates the checksum, and reads the data back. Each write requires confirmation. Unsupported game actions stay local. Keep the backup file in case recovery is needed.
